zh: Wren摸黑点了一圈蜡烛。火苗一跳一跳，把每个人的脸都照软了。
Nico的小臂内侧，还留着刚才那只手的温度，被拇指蹭过的那块皮肤一直在发烫。

then: Theo挨着Nico坐下，膝盖抵着他的膝盖，隔着湿透的布料一点点压实了。
你刚才那句话，我当真了。别想赖。
Theo隔着两张凳子坐下，低头拿蜡烛烤手。
反正我走不走，你都能拿来开玩笑。

停电不停局。转瓶子，真心话——谁敢撒谎，罚他亲左手边那个。

Theo在烛光里抬眼，盯着Nico，一眨不眨。
lose: 瓶子转了三圈，慢悠悠停下——瓶口正对Nico。
Theo在烛光里抬眼，盯着Nico，一眨不眨。
zh.q: 在场有没有你喜欢的人？

zh: Nico。在场有没有你喜欢的人？
全场安静。Theo的杯子停在半空。

then: Nico把纸条翻过来。背面有一行字，被划了三道，还是看得清。
“如果你让我留下，我就不走了。”
Theo看见他在看那一行，耳根一下红透，伸手就要抢。
那句不算。写错了。还给我。
Nico把纸条举高。Theo扑过来，整个人压上他，两个人撞在冰柜门上。
背后是冰柜的冷气，身前是Theo滚烫的胸口。他一只手撑在Nico耳边，喘着气。
……你要是念出来，我就当你同意了。
Nico张了张嘴。Theo盯着他的嘴唇，喉结滚了一下。
他没退，额头抵着Nico的额头，等。

他勾住Nico围裙的系带，往自己这边轻轻一拽。鼻尖碰到鼻尖。再近一点，就——

zh: Theo猛地退开半步，手指还勾着那根系带，没松。那一点距离，又回来了。
纸条还在Nico手心里，被攥出了褶。
en: Wren lit a ring of candles in the dark. The flames jumped and made every face look softer.
The inside of Nico's forearm still held the heat of that hand. The patch of skin the thumb had stroked wouldn't stop burning.

then: Theo sat down right next to Nico and pressed his knee against Nico's, through soaked denim, firmer and firmer.
What you said down there—I'm taking it seriously. Don't you dare take it back.
Theo sat two stools away, warming his hands over a candle.
Guess me leaving is just another bit to you.
else: Theo took the stool farthest from Nico.
You said I should go. Fine. I'm listening.

en: Wren slapped an empty bottle on the bar, thumb pressing the strip of tape on its base.
Power's out, party's not. Spin the bottle. Truth only—anyone who lies has to kiss whoever's on their left.

en.hint: Wren taped the bottom of the bottle. She already knows where it's going to stop.
win: Three spins, a slow wobble — and it stopped pointing dead at Nico.
Oh no. What are the odds.
Across the candles, Theo lifted his eyes to Nico and didn't blink.
lose: Three spins, a slow wobble — and it stopped pointing dead at Nico.
Oh no. What are the odds.
Across the candles, Theo lifted his eyes to Nico and didn't blink.
skip: No spin? Fine. I'll just ask you.
en.q: Is there someone in this room you like?

en: Nico. Is there someone in this room you like?
Dead silence. Theo's glass stopped halfway to his mouth.

en.hint: Everyone's looking at you. So is Theo.

opts.t: Nope. The only thing I love is this bar.
then: Wren rolled her eyes so hard it was audible.
One word. Nico could hear the disappointment in it.

opts.t: Yes. Not telling you who.
then: Theo didn't join in. He watched Nico, throat working.
...Does he know? Because if he doesn't, he's an idiot.

opts.t: You first. What about you, Theo?
then: Theo froze for a second. Then smiled.
Yeah. He's less than a fist away from me right now.
There was a wall on Theo's left. On his right, only Nico.

en: My turn. Mason — were you the one who told the coach?

en.title: Mason Snaps
en.txt: Mason slammed the table. "It was me. I'd rather you hate me than watch you wreck that leg."

en: Rowan mouthed at Wren: One down. One to go.
Wren nodded, clicked her recorder, and pulled up a file from five years ago.
Five years ago, Theo bombed a black-box show. By curtain, one person was left in the audience.

en.txt: One guy in the whole house — third row, on the aisle — clapping like he was a hundred people… Wherever I end up, I'm always coming back to drink at Nico's bar. That's a promise.
en.hint: Theo got drunk that night five years ago. Wren's recorder was running.
then: Theo lunged for it, half his weight landing on Nico's shoulder. Wren held it way over her head.
"Wherever I end up." I've been saving that for five years.
skip: Not listening? Fine. It's a family heirloom now.

en: Theo gave up. He was still leaning on Nico's shoulder, looking at him from that close, ears burning red.

en.hint: Every show he's done since, you sat third row, on the aisle. He noticed.

opts.t: I sat in that seat for five years. You think I was there for the plays?
then: ...Then what were you there for? Say it.
Theo's knuckles went white on the glass.

opts.t: Drunk promises don't count.
then: He said it fast, like he was scared Nico would take it back.

opts.t: Retreat behind the bar. "I need more ice."
then: Behind him, Wren let out a loud sigh.
Theo watched him go and didn't follow.

en: Wren hooked Theo's arm. "Guest of honor. Candles. Now." Nico retreated behind the bar alone.
The emergency light glowed green. He wiped his hands on his apron — and his fingers hit a stiff corner in the pocket.
Under the Polaroid was a piece of paper, folded small. He hadn't put it there.
"N — five years of you remembering everyone's drink and everyone's birthday. Today it's my turn to remember you. Happy birthday. — T"
The clock flipped to 12:00. It was Nico's birthday. He hadn't told anyone.

en.hint: It's midnight. Nobody remembered your birthday. Except him.

opts.t: When did he even slip this in…
then: Nico remembered Theo squeezing past behind him, chest to his back, for half a second. He'd pressed so hard the T dented the paper.

opts.t: Flip the note over and back. Read it a third time.
then: "Today it's my turn to remember you." In five years, he was the only one who ever took the tray out of Nico's hands.

opts.t: …You idiot.
then: Barely a whisper. Only Nico heard it. His eyes stung.

t: theo
He found it. He's reading it a third time. I'm at the other end of the bar pretending to look for lemons, palms soaked.
rowan
Half a pad of sticky notes for those few lines. Theo, don't let them go to waste.
wren
His birthday? He forgot it himself. Only that idiot remembered. ...Crying a little doesn't count, right?

en: Rowan squeezed behind the bar. "Scoot. Ethan's knee is swelling up. Ice pack." The freezer was right at Nico's feet.
He crouched for the ice, looked up, and saw the paper in Nico's hand. He knew that handwriting.
Rowan glanced back. Theo was in the far corner, pinned down by Wren and a box of candles. Out of earshot.
He made me swear not to tell you. But he leaves at seven.

en.title: Rowan's Secret
en.txt: "He never signed the five-year contract. He's waiting for someone to ask him to stay."

en.why: He spent all night on that note

en: He spent all last night on that note. Went through half a pad. You know exactly who he's waiting for.
Rowan left with the ice pack. Passing Wren, they snuck a high five.
Theo came around the bar without a word and rested his forehead on Nico's shoulder.
Don't move. Just for a second.

then: His breath burned through Nico's T-shirt, right into his collarbone. He was still in Nico's hoodie, sleeves over his fingertips.
else: His breath burned through Nico's T-shirt. His hair was still damp, cool against Nico's neck.

en.hint: His forehead's on your shoulder. The whole room has gone quiet.

opts.t: Bring a hand up to the back of his neck.
then: Theo went rigid. Then, bit by bit, he gave in, nose buried in the curve of Nico's neck.
Nico… don't. I'll take it seriously.

opts.t: Just a second?
then: Theo lifted his head, less than a fist away from Nico's face.

opts.t: Don't move. Don't even breathe.
then: Theo laughed softly, breath grazing Nico's neck.
Holding your breath won't help. I can hear your heart right through your shirt.

t: theo
The second he held the back of my neck my knees gave out. Five years—he was waiting too. Why am I even leaving.
rowan
Ice pack on Ethan's knee, turn around—yeah. My work here is done.
wren
Everyone's holding their breath. Whoever makes a sound right now goes in the flooded basement. By my hand.

en: Theo's eyes dropped to Nico's mouth and stayed there.
The note… you found it, didn't you.

en.title: The Back of the Note
en.teaser: There's one more line on the back of the note. He crossed it out three times.
then: Nico turns the note over. One more line on the back, crossed out three times — still legible.
"If you ask me to stay, I won't go."
Theo sees what he's reading and goes red to the ears. He lunges for it.
That one doesn't count. Mistake. Give it back.
Nico holds it up high. Theo crowds in, his whole body pressing Nico back into the freezer door.
Cold air at Nico's back, Theo's burning chest against his front. One hand braced by Nico's ear, breathing hard.
...Read it out loud and I'll take that as a yes.
Nico's lips part. Theo's eyes drop to them; his throat moves.
He doesn't back off. Forehead to Nico's forehead, waiting.

en: He lifted a hand. His thumb brushed Nico's lower lip, barely there, like he was making sure of something.
He hooked a finger in Nico's apron strings and tugged him in. Nose brushed nose. One inch closer and—

en.prompt: Candlelit bar at midnight, two men forehead to forehead, almost kissing, no text

en: A crash from the basement — like something giving way.
Theo jerked back half a step, finger still caught in the apron string. The distance was back.
The note was still in Nico's palm, creased from his grip.

zh: Nico从吧台后面走出来，把那张折成小方块的纸条，放在Theo面前。

zh.hint: 纸条在你们中间。他在等你先开口。

opts.t: 写得这么肉麻，打算什么时候当面念给我听？
then: ……嗯，我写的，趁你擦杯子塞进去的。当面念？你确定你顶得住？

opts.t: 你怎么知道今天是我生日？
then: 你的事，你以为我哪件不知道？

zh: 第一年冬天，你在吧台喝多了，说你生日在零点之后。说完你自己就忘了。
Nico想起来了。每年这一晚，Theo都会来，一直坐到打烊。
零点一过，他就会把Nico手里的抹布抽走：“歇会儿。”
你记得所有人。我就想有一天，换我记着你。
Theo伸手，把Nico额前一缕湿头发拨开。指尖顺着太阳穴滑到耳后，停住了。
我还以为……我在你那儿，跟别人没什么不一样。
Nico的心狠狠撞了一下。耳后被他碰过的那块，烫得发麻。
他停住了。嘴张了张，没说下去。
他的指尖还停在Nico耳后。两个人就这么站着，谁也没先移开眼。
Rowan在角落里攥紧了拳头，嘴型是：说啊。
Theo口袋里的手机震了一下。
他低头看了一眼，脸色变了。
屏幕上一行字：您的航班状态已变更。
en: Nico came out from behind the bar and set the little folded note down in front of Theo.
Wren clapped a hand over Ethan's mouth before he could whoop.

en.hint: The note is between you. He's waiting for you to go first.

opts.t: Pretty sappy. When were you planning to read it to my face?
then: ...Yeah, I wrote it. Slipped it in while you were drying glasses. Read it to your face? You sure you could handle that?

en: That first winter, you got drunk behind the bar and told me your birthday starts right after midnight. Then you forgot you'd said it.
Nico remembered. Every year, on this night, Theo showed up and stayed till closing.
Right after midnight, he'd pull the bar rag out of Nico's hand. "Take five."
You remember everybody. I just wanted one day where somebody remembered you.
Theo reached up and brushed a damp strand of hair off Nico's forehead. His fingertips slid along his temple to behind his ear, and stayed.
I figured… to you, I was just like everybody else.
Nico's heart slammed against his ribs. The skin behind his ear, where Theo had touched it, tingled hot.
He stopped. His lips parted, and nothing came out.
His fingertips were still resting behind Nico's ear. They just stood there. Neither of them looked away.
In the corner Rowan clenched his fist, mouthing: Say it.
Theo's phone buzzed in his pocket.
He glanced down, and his face changed.
One line on the screen: Your flight status has changed.

Theo走到窗边，额头贴着玻璃看雨，呵出的气在玻璃上糊开一小片白。
雨这么大，明天也飞不了吧。

Nico的手隔着围裙，按住了那张纸条。
Theo回头看了他一眼。那眼神，失落得藏都藏不住。

The Polaroid was still in there — the one Wren had shoved in earlier.
The fourth shot. Theo not looking at the camera. Looking at him.
At the other end of the bar, Theo saw.

Nico knew that look. It's the one he gets onstage when he's lost his line.

en: Wren clicked her recorder. "Year five. Still nobody's said it."
Theo drifted to the window and leaned his forehead on the glass, watching the rain, his breath fogging a small patch white.
Rain like this… there's no way I'm flying tomorrow.
He could've been asking himself. Or asking Nico.
Through the apron, Nico pressed his hand flat over the note.
Theo looked back at him once. He couldn't hide how let down he was.
Water's rising again! It's past the fifth step!
Everyone ran for the stairs. Theo didn't move. He was still looking at Nico.

Theo背对着门，在打电话，声音压得很低。
对，七点十分那班……能改吗？
门里突然安静了。航班状态，变了。
en: Nico stepped up on a stool and held the note over his head.

en.hint: Everyone's looking up at you. Theo's gone pale.

opts.t: Somebody left me a note. I'm reading it out loud.
Clear your throat and just read it.
then: Wren aimed her recorder straight at him.

en: "N — five years of you remembering everyone's drink and everyone's birthday. Today it's my turn to remember you. Happy birthday. — T"
Nico! Five years and you never told us!
Mason stuck a candle in a lemon wedge and held it out.
Rowan started "Happy Birthday" and everyone joined in, wildly off-key.
Nico ended up in the middle of it all, grinning so hard his eyes squeezed shut.
When he blew out the candle, he glanced past the crowd.
The kitchen door was still swinging.
Wren leaned in, hissing: "You read his note to the whole room?"
It took him five years to work up the nerve to write that.
The lemon wedge in Nico's hand suddenly smelled sour.
He went to the kitchen door. Candlelight leaked through the gap.
Theo had his back to the door, on the phone, voice low.
Yeah, the seven-ten… can I change it?
Then the kitchen went quiet. The flight status had changed.
